completed_claims: For smooth local unit-viscosity NS, the two-scale full-gradient entropy balance keeps both slices, cutoff time/Laplacian/transport, the near matrix N_r and harmonic pressure. Its standard bounds still contain C theta^(-1) E(r); the harmonic term is C theta^2(Hcal(r)+E(r)), with no extra time-decay factor.

Classical div-curl Hardy control of every component of N_r and Hardy-BMO duality give a small oscillatory near-field term only if the actual cutoff matrix test phi(B0-W) has an additionally small BMO coefficient. Constant-matrix cutoff integrals remain. Exact amplitude-scaled rank-one heat shears have Theta=0 and shrinking A,E,mu budgets but unchanged positive local unit-direction oscillation, so they exclude an automatic unweighted BMO smallness modulus.

For the SN initial family but a different normalized joint source I=integral B0:(G^2+Hess p), p_epsilon=epsilon^2(-cos2y-cos4z/4). The initial whole-cell pressure pairing is exactly zero by parity, and I=-6epsilon integral cos^2y cos^2(2z)/q_epsilon<0. Thus -I>=12pi^3epsilon/sqrt(5+17epsilon^2), whereas integral d(G)^2<=50pi^3epsilon^2. I changes sign under negation of an initial velocity with its own canonical pressure.

The transverse velocity is an exact heat multiple of a steady two-dimensional Euler field. Coupling it to the axial linear advection-diffusion equation constructs full smooth periodic NS solutions for every finite time. The axial second-order remainder obeys an explicit forced parabolic equation and is O_T(epsilon^2) in every fixed C_t C^k norm.

For every fixed finite T, I(u_epsilon(t))=-epsilon kappa(t)+O_T(epsilon^2), with explicit positive kappa(t)>=12pi^3 exp(-10nu t)/sqrt5, uniformly on [0,T]. The normalized-gradient denominator cancels against the first-order matrix factor, including background zeros. Any fixed positive-age interval therefore has first-order joint production and only second-order integral d^2, ruling out a pure-quadratic production bound without other terms.
open_items: The counterexample does not exclude delta*mu_G+C_delta*d^2 or other mixed absorption: the rank-one background has nonzero O(1) original direction dissipation. Positive production is not net gradient-norm growth.

No unconditional mixed signed near-field estimate yields an absorbable or summable critical remainder. Classical Hardy pairing supplies no automatic small BMO coefficient and does not remove transport, cutoff or slice terms.

No arbitrary actual NS evolution has been shown to generate the required prescribed-centre small normalized shape dissipation and common A+E+D cap. Pressure-Hessian control does not replace pressure normalization.

The full periodic pressure pairing is exactly zero only on the listed initial slices; its first-order term vanishes along the constructed solution, but exact positive-time cancellation is not claimed. Special x-independent globally smooth solutions are not singularity constructions.

Effective thresholds, optimality, novelty certification, human peer review and general three-dimensional global regularity remain open. Finite algebra checks do not certify continuum integrals or parabolic evolution.
